WITH ordered_drives AS (
  SELECT
    end_place,
    end_lat,
    end_lng,
    ended_at,
    LEAD(started_at) OVER (ORDER BY started_at) AS next_drive_at
  FROM drives
  WHERE vehicle_id = ${vehicle_id}
),
visits AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(
      NULLIF(BTRIM(od.end_place), ''),
      pc.display_name,
      CONCAT(
        ROUND(od.end_lat::numeric, 4), ', ',
        ROUND(od.end_lng::numeric, 4)
      )
    ) AS location,
    od.end_lat AS latitude,
    od.end_lng AS longitude,
    pc.city,
    pc.state,
    pc.country,
    pc.category,
    od.ended_at AS visited_at,
    CASE
      WHEN COALESCE(od.next_drive_at, $__timeTo()) > od.ended_at THEN
        EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
          LEAST(COALESCE(od.next_drive_at, $__timeTo()), $__timeTo()) - od.ended_at
        )) / 60.0
      ELSE NULL
    END AS duration_min
  FROM ordered_drives od
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT
      cached.display_name,
      cached.city,
      cached.state,
      cached.country,
      cached.category
    FROM places_cache cached
    WHERE od.end_lat IS NOT NULL
      AND od.end_lng IS NOT NULL
      AND 6371000 * ACOS(LEAST(1.0,
        COS(RADIANS(od.end_lat)) * COS(RADIANS(cached.latitude))
          * COS(RADIANS(cached.longitude) - RADIANS(od.end_lng))
        + SIN(RADIANS(od.end_lat)) * SIN(RADIANS(cached.latitude))
      )) <= 50
    ORDER BY cached.last_used_at DESC
    LIMIT 1
  ) pc ON TRUE
  WHERE od.ended_at IS NOT NULL
    AND $__timeFilter(od.ended_at)
    AND (
      NULLIF(BTRIM(od.end_place), '') IS NOT NULL
      OR (od.end_lat IS NOT NULL AND od.end_lng IS NOT NULL)
    )
)
SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT city) FILTER (WHERE city IS NOT NULL) AS "🏙️ Cities",
  COUNT(DISTINCT state) FILTER (WHERE state IS NOT NULL) AS "🗺️ States",
  COUNT(DISTINCT country) FILTER (WHERE country IS NOT NULL) AS "🌍 Countries",
  COUNT(DISTINCT location) AS "📍 Locations",
  COUNT(*) AS "🔄 Total Visits",
  ROUND((SUM(duration_min) / 60.0)::numeric, 0) AS "⏱️ Total Hours"
FROM visits

SELECT
  AVG(latitude) AS latitude,
  AVG(longitude) AS longitude,
  location AS name,
  COUNT(*) AS visits,
  MAX(city) AS city,
  MAX(state) AS state
FROM visits
WHERE latitude IS NOT NULL AND longitude IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY location
ORDER BY visits DESC

SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN location ILIKE '%Home%' OR location ILIKE '%Residence%' THEN '🏠 '
    WHEN location ILIKE '%Office%' THEN '🏢 '
    WHEN location ILIKE '%Supercharger%' THEN '⚡ '
    WHEN location ILIKE '%Hotel%' THEN '🏨 '
    WHEN location ILIKE '%Resort%' THEN '🏖️ '
    WHEN location ILIKE '%Costco%' OR location ILIKE '%Walmart%' THEN '🛒 '
    WHEN location ILIKE '%Service%' THEN '🔧 '
    ELSE '📍 '
  END || location AS "📍 Location",
  COALESCE(MAX(city), '') AS "🏙️ City",
  COALESCE(MAX(state), '') AS "🗺️ State",
  COALESCE(MAX(country), '') AS "🌍 Country",
  COUNT(*) AS "🔄 Visits",
  ROUND((SUM(duration_min) / 60.0)::numeric, 1) AS "⏱️ Hours",
  TO_CHAR(MAX(visited_at), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "📅 Last Visit"
FROM visits
GROUP BY location
ORDER BY "🔄 Visits" DESC
LIMIT 30

      OR location ILIKE '%Residence%' THEN '🏠 Home'
    WHEN category ILIKE '%work%' OR location ILIKE '%Office%' THEN '🏢 Work'
    WHEN location ILIKE '%Supercharger%' THEN '⚡ Supercharger'
    WHEN category ILIKE '%hotel%' OR location ILIKE '%Hotel%' THEN '🏨 Hotel'
    WHEN category ILIKE '%shop%' OR location ILIKE '%Costco%'
      OR location ILIKE '%Walmart%' THEN '🛒 Shopping'

    ELSE '📍 Other'
  END AS "🏷️ Type",
  COUNT(*) AS "🔄 Visits"
FROM visits
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY "🔄 Visits" DESC
